paragraphs: I'm a fourth-year student at Far Eastern University - Alabang, taking a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology with a specialization in web and mobile applications. I build full-stack web apps, including the UI/UX: the interface people use, the backend behind it, and the deployment that keeps it live.

I focus mostly on web development, UI/UX design and system design, and I'm still learning machine learning. Most of what I know comes from building real projects, such as the web platform for my capstone, gameplay systems, Java plugins, and a trip planner I'm building on my own.
contactLine: I'm open to UI/UX and frontend internships.
